name: Míng
source:
Owner and head chef at Millennium Kitchen. His food is so good, Alice pays him to work at the casino restaurant, too. He's lived in the island long before she ever showed up, and the residents respect him deeply. 

[From the [url=https://romanesque.site/en/]official website[/url]]
